annotations.title: Tokenised deposit networks for a bank

description: Given a bank name or BIC (e.g. 'DBS' or 'CHASUS33'), the tokenised deposit networks public sources place it on (Kinexys, DBS Token Services, Partior, the Swift shared ledger), with its role, the network's status (live, pilot, announced) and the source for each. Says "not enough evidence yet" when no public source places the bank on a network. Same lookup: GET https://swapeazi.io/api/v1/tokenised-routes/banks?q=...

bank.description: A bank name (e.g. DBS, J.P. Morgan, Standard Chartered) or a BIC (8 or 11 characters).
